name: contention-reachable-only-via-real-unreadable-db
body: The freshness contention arm is reachable only through a genuinely locked or unreadable `db.lbug`, and the retry budget is the fixed `FRESHNESS_READ_BUDGET` constant — the sleeper is injected but the budget is not; upgrade by making the budget an injectable parameter if a test ever needs to drive exhaustion deterministically.
